purpose: Quantify how a validated coordinate-space CShM record changes between atom-mapped tmQM/GFN2-xTB and tmQMg/PBE geometries without treating either pipeline as ground truth.

cohort.definition: The previously frozen 31,121 exact-ID overlap with identical atom sequences and both xTB and PBE Cartesian coordinates.

implementation_gate.required_method: central-metal-fixed coordinate-space CShM with CN+1 centering, proper Kabsch rotation, optimal uniform scale, and exhaustive donor-template permutations

primary_estimands.name: supported_shape_retention_fixed_donor_set
primary_estimands.denominator: records with corrected CShM available at both geometries, supported CN2-CN6 at both geometries, identical CN, and identical donor atom indices
primary_estimands.numerator: same corrected best-shape label at xTB and PBE

primary_estimands.name: boundary_status_retention_fixed_donor_set
primary_estimands.denominator: same as supported_shape_retention_fixed_donor_set and CN having at least two reference shapes
primary_estimands.numerator: same binary boundary status at xTB and PBE

primary_estimands.name: continuous_shape_displacement_fixed_donor_set
primary_estimands.quantity: L-infinity and L2 change in the vector of unrounded corrected CShM values over the same ordered reference-shape names

secondary_estimands.name: supported_shape_retention_same_cn
secondary_estimands.denominator: records with corrected CShM available at both geometries and the same supported CN2-CN6; donor exchange is allowed

secondary_estimands.name: implementation_transition_matrix
secondary_estimands.quantity: frozen archived best-shape label versus corrected best-shape label, reported separately for xTB and PBE and by coordination number

secondary_estimands.name: unsupported_and_failure_accounting
secondary_estimands.quantity: full-denominator counts for CN outside 2-6, missing geometry, serializer failure, non-finite score, and any other exclusion; no silent deletion

uncertainty.continuous_intervals: 20,000 canonical-graph-cluster bootstrap replicates where graph groups are available; otherwise record bootstrap is labeled descriptive
uncertainty.transition_tables: counts and row-normalized percentages with exact denominators

claim_boundary: This is a paired data-provenance and geometry-sensitivity audit, not a validation of one electronic-structure method against another.
Best-shape retention does not establish chemical-state dynamics, reaction pathways, thermodynamic stability, or experimental correctness.
No shape-defined property subgroup may be reported from the archived frozen labels.
Any property analysis must be a separately locked secondary join performed only after the structural manifest and its SHA-256 digest are frozen.
